name: YJ MGC EST 3x3
description: The MGC EST 3x3 is the latest 3x3 from YJ. YJ has done its best to innovate in the 3x3 space, with this cube having cutouts on the edges as well as a completely unique adjustment system. The YJ MGC EST 3x3, while having a non-standard look, has good performance right out of the box. If you enjoy puzzles with personality, don't miss this one.
